identityNote: CustKey/ProdKey are not fabricated for document evidence. Exact selected year+major+AWB, unique subweek and country/shared Colombia pool determine the target. Multiple farm headers of one AWB are normal; freight/weight pseudo-products do not determine goods country.

actions.name: UPLOAD_FIRST_PAGE_OCR
actions.sideEffect: Bounded ZIP/PDF streaming, private temporary queue; each PDF first page only, same-page 2000/3000px bounded retry. ZIP 25MiB base64 JSON uses exact nginx 36m / Next 36mb request limit; worker OCR POST exact nginx 2m / Next 2mb, PDF GET response remains 18mb. Non-JSON HTTP errors never expose response bodies. No paid provider, no packing worker change. Server persists parsed financial receipt only, never complete OCR/PII.

actions.name: PREVIEW_AND_APPLY_FILE_EVIDENCE
actions.sideEffect: Worker callback auto-registers exact same-year AWB/current-scope receipts with no unexplained amount conflict; net/gross-equal representations reconciled using receipt evidence. Other-year excluded, exact other major requires explicit destination confirmation; unmatched manual combined AWB requires exact currency+sum foreign amount+GW. Shared policy rechecks in global root lock, declaration uniqueness across year ledgers prevents duplicate after scope change. Scoped atomic files only; all DB DML/DDL/SP forbidden. Partial failure and replay idempotent; UI closure does not prevent automatic processing.

actions.name: READ_MISSING_COST_OVERLAY
actions.sideEffect: Approved typed actual receipt source takes precedence in read-only calculation; existing DB bytes remain unchanged. Real conflicts/ItemCount require explicit review; no unauthenticated reinterpretation of legacy money. Import VAT excluded, country gross except Vietnam net, Colombia handling/actual agency net. Existing snapshots/confirmed report money preserved, past report refresh explicit user action. Replay requires explicit external evidence; live context cache and before/after file digest fence.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 same AWB+35-01; wrong-year document/ledger file, multiple subweeks/countries, zero/manual/split-part conflict, shared Colombia pool and absent exact AWB. No prior-year match or fallback.
